device.description: 8-bit 100 ns current-output multiplying DAC with complementary outputs and unlatched TTL/CMOS inputs (+-0.1 % nonlinearity grade)
device.note: dac0800.pdf (SNAS538C) p.2 (operating conditions: V+ = (V-)+10 to (V-)+30 V, V- -15 to -5 V), p.3 (logic levels VIL 0.8 V, VIH 2.0 V, tPLH/tPHL 60 ns, PSSIFS+ 4.5 V <= V+ <= 18 V), p.4 (Figures 2-3 connection diagrams, block diagram), p.1 (power supply range +-4.5 V to +-18 V)

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: no latch: the code is whatever the B1-B8 / A1-A8 inputs hold

commands.name: DATA
commands.note: unlatched logic inputs: the current switches follow the inputs directly

pages: p.1 (features: +-4.5 to +-18 V supplies, TTL/CMOS inputs), p.2 (operating conditions), p.3 (electrical characteristics: logic levels, propagation delay, settling), p.4 (connection diagrams PDIP/SOIC, block diagram)
notModeled: the digital inputs are unlatched (no CS/WR/LDAC): the current switches follow B1-B8 directly; modeled as a parallel bus with no control pins whose data word is written (and the output updated) as the inputs change
complementary current outputs IOUT (pin 4) and IOUT-bar (pin 2): both are named IOUT (the overbar cannot be written in a pin name); analog, never driven
reference amplifier (VREF(+), VREF(-)), compensation, multiplying operation, output compliance (all analog)
logic threshold control VLC (pin 1) shifts the input threshold for ECL/CMOS/PMOS logic; the model uses the TTL thresholds (VLC = 0 V)
propagation delay tPLH/tPHL 60 ns max and settling time 100-150 ns
negative supply V- (-15 to -5 V) is in "analog" (the voltage check cannot represent a negative supply)
logic input swing -10 V to +18 V (V- = -15 V): inputs above V+ are not modeled
variants: DAC0800 (+-0.19 % nonlinearity) and DAC0802 (+-0.1 %) share the datasheet, pinouts and logic; DAC0800C/DAC0802C are the commercial grades. Pin numbers differ between PDIP and SOIC (Figures 2-3).
